'''Millie''' was a [[MILL-247-EE industrial droid|MILL-247-EE]] emergency service [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on [[Tem Chesko]]'s [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].

==Biography==
While on a run to deliver [[syntonium crystal]]s from [[Cirus II]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] collided with Chesko's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], causing significant damage to the ships systems, notably the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Without a hyperdrive the journey, which would take around two weeks with a functional drive, would take 71 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to complete.

Approximately 8 years into the voyage, the human discovered Millie in an emergency storage compartment and activated her.

Over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Millie developed a close relationship with Tem, the two being stranded on a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] for seventy years together. Despite Millie's synthetic nature, they developed feelings for each other, to the point that Millie once attempted to [[Death|destroy herself]] when she believed he missed his former girlfriend, [[Maia (Tem Chesko)|Maia]], more than he cared for her.

As her companion aged and his health declined, she took care of him. Eventually he handed her a [[Laser knife/Legends|laser knife]] and asked her to end his life. Instead, she sacrificed herself to make a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic replacement]] for his failing [[heart]] from her own internal components.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|I scored fair and square with that shot Millie!''"<br/>"''You are in error, Tem Chesko&hellip;''"<br/>"''Am not!''"<br/>"''Are too.''"<br/>"Not!"<br/>"''Are.|Tem Chesko and Millie, after a game|<ref name="MostlyAutomatic" />}}
[[File:CheskoDejarik.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Millie played a game of Dejarik with Tem Chesko aboard his cargo hauler.]]
Millie was stored on Tem Chesko's hauler behind glass, only to be broken in case of emergency. Once out of containment, Millie would clean for Chesko, whom she addressed with his full name. With the droid's presence, Chesko's mental state and outlook on his life improved, and the pair would play games with each other.<ref name="MostlyAutomatic" />

Millie and Chesko, because of the years they spent together in close proximity, knew each other well, though that did not stop Millie from thinking she was not pleasing enough for the Human. The droid attempted to short circuit herself in a pool, but was stopped by Chesko, who assured her she meant more to him than any other woman he had ever known. Chesko also told the droid that she would always be in his heart.<ref name="MostlyAutomatic" />

Millie aided Chesko during his health problems, though in one instance he berated the droid for acting like a mother. When Chesko instructed her to end his life, she stated she would never leave him and instead provided him her steel heart. Chesko later looked back upon that day as the hardest day of his life. Millie had [[Gender/Legends|feminine programming]], and [[Color/Legends|blue]] sensors, and was plated in green and gray. She was an expert on medical procedures and attempted her best when dealing with Chesko.<ref name="MostlyAutomatic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Millie first appeared in "[[Tales from Mos Eisley: Mostly Automatic]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Bruce Jones]] and illustrated by [[Bret Blevins]]. The story was published as part of the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''<ref name="MostlyAutomatic" /> in [[April]] [[1995]].<ref name="Parent release date">{{GalaxyCite|2|Rebel Report}}</ref>
